scope: Spring transaction proxy entry through return after commit; real allocator, ticket insert, inventory update, DTO work and durable outbox insert. Async event delivery mocked; external locks, HTTP, Redis admission and remote order excluded.
fixture: 5 stations, 1200 physical seats, 50 independent candidate carriages, 24 seats each. Each batch starts empty and each worker buys 20 single tickets in its own carriage, without retries; occupancy rises to 20/24. Ten batches per arm/round; resets and reconciliation excluded from active-window throughput.
